messages:
zoe-support: FYI forwarding customer message from ACME (acct acme-42). They say invoice inv_2028_00321 created 2028-03-01 shows a full charge for Feb even though they downgraded on 2028-02-15. Customer insists a prorated credit and that the credit note must reference PO #PO-9876. Filed ZD-5123.

jess-billing: assigned. quick peek: GET /v1/invoices/inv_2028_00321 shows "po_number": null, "tax_override": true, "proration_applied": false. Looks like proration didn't run. Any charge_attempt logs?

billing-bot: Automated: charge_attempt failed for cust acme-42 - code=402_001 card_decline at 2028-02-15T09:32:10Z (req=ch_8xYz).

olga-finance: If proration_applied=false that's why no prorated credit. Two possibilities: 1) PO not present at invoice creation so our auto-credit path skipped attaching PO metadata; 2) proration logic bypassed when tax_override=true. We need repro steps from customer and API request ids.

mike-eng: I'll pull backend traces. Any API request id or UI action id from the customer session?

zoe-support: Customer's repro in their words: 1) Subscribed to Pro Jan 01; 2) Downgraded to Starter via the org UI on Feb 15; 3) On Mar 01 they received invoice inv_2028_00321 showing full Pro charge for Feb + Starter charge for Mar (double billed). They attached screenshot + PO #PO-9876 and said they added PO to account after invoice issued.

jess-billing: Ok. Plan: create a manual credit note that references the original invoice and includes PO metadata so accounting matches customer PO report. What GL code should we use? Amount estimated $350 prorated credit.

olga-finance: Use GL CJ-2105 for customer refunds/credits. Important: our automated credit flow only attaches PO if invoice.metadata.po_number exists at invoice creation. If PO is added later we do NOT retro-attach automatically. For manual credit create via API with payload something like:

```json
POST /v1/credit_notes
{
  "invoice_id": "inv_2028_00321",
  "amount": 35000,
  "currency": "USD",
  "metadata": {"po_number": "PO-9876", "reason": "mid-cycle downgrade prorated credit"},
  "gl_code": "CJ-2105"
}
```

Also include original invoice_id in the credit note lines so it can be reconciled.

mike-eng: I dug into commits. Root cause: proration path is conditionally skipped when tax_override=true — that was introduced by a 2027-12 patch to handle legacy tax adjustments. The code path incorrectly returns early before computing prorated line items. I can reproduce locally with a test: downgrade + tax_override flag -> no proration. Opening PR to restore proration before tax handling and add regression test.

zoe-support: I've created ZD-5123 and linked it to Jira BF-7890 for engineering. Customer asked for ETA on credit application.

jess-billing: I created manual credit note CN-2028-1102 today for $350.00, metadata.po_number=PO-9876, linked to inv_2028_00321 and issued it. Please confirm the credit is reflected on customer portal and that accounting sees PO on CN.

olga-finance: Confirmed CN-2028-1102 is posted and shows PO-9876 in metadata. Marking for reconciliation run tomorrow. I'll update GL CJ-2105.

mike-eng: PR submitted: github.com/redwood-inference/billing/pull/1423 — includes fix + unit test. Deploy to staging today, targeting prod deploy in ~3 business days assuming no regressions.

zoe-support: Customer notified: "We've issued credit CN-2028-1102 for $350 and attached your PO-9876; it should reflect in the portal within 24h. Engineering is working on a permanent fix; tracking ticket BF-7890."

jess-billing: Please close out once customer confirms. Add a short runbook entry for "PO added after invoice -> manual credit required" so support can action faster next time. :white_check_mark:

olga-finance: I'll author the runbook and add to /docs/billing/runbooks/po-post-invoice.md. Assign to billing ops.

mike-eng: adding monitoring alert to catch future occurrences where proration_applied=false on invoices after downgrade events. Also adding integration test for UI downgrade flow.

zoe-support: Customer replied: "Saw credit, portal shows negative balance applied — thanks. Please proceed with fix so it doesn't happen again." Closing ZD-5123 after reconciliation.

jess-billing: resolved then. Thanks team.
